items.title: Joseph "Red" Clark Interview, 1959-01-13
items.q: And fella by the name of Henry Williams, he don't play anymore now. He's a minister now.

ctx.x: Do you remember any of them?

Well Anderson Minor, we called him Gulley, he was taking bass at that time. And Joe Harris, which is dead, he was taking trombone. And another fella by the name of Jefferson Butler, he was a trumpet player, he's dead. And fella by the name of Henry Williams, he don't play anymore now. He's a minister now. And Felix Goff, clarinet. What did Henry Williams play?
